title: Menlo Math — Middle-School Math App Redesign
jpTitle: Menlo Math：中学校向け数学アプリのリデザイン

summary.en: Redesigned navigation and information architecture for a middle-school pre-algebra iPad app so each unit's real-world scenario — soccer-team budgeting, 3D printing — was visible up front through a photographic card system and narrative framing, replacing a generic gray-tile interface while keeping the same underlying simulation and data tools.
summary.jp: 中学生向け数学アプリの土台はすでにしっかりしていた。足りなかったのは各単元の物語が最初に見えないことだけ。灰色タイルの画面を写真カードと物語の語り口に置き換え、計算機能はそのまま残した。

product.en: The underlying math tools were already solid — the redesign is entirely a legibility fix, making each unit's story visible before a student opens it, so a soccer-budgeting unit doesn't look identical to a 3D-printing one.
product.jp: 数学の仕組み自体はすでに良かった。作り直したのは見え方だけ。開く前に各単元の物語が分かるようにした。サッカーの予算編成と 3D プリントの単元を見分けられるようにした。

mine: Redesigned the navigation and information architecture around each unit's existing real-world scenario
Turned the home screen into a photographic card grid with plain-language subtitles (e.g. 'Ratio' → 'True Color Murals')
Reframed unit overviews with narrative framing ('We got a job for you!')
Turned investigations into discoverable cards instead of a numbered grid
Set activity screens inside a themed scene while keeping the same underlying tools
team: Curriculum Team (SunBay Math), Product Stakeholders and a Developer — credited on the page by role title, without individual task breakdown

label.en: curriculum units restructured around real-world scenarios

narrative.problem: Every unit looked the same: a plain list of titles, a grid of numbered gray tiles, and a repeating thumbnail for every activity — nothing signaled which unit was a soccer-team budgeting problem and which was a 3D-printing challenge, so students couldn't tell one activity from the next until they opened it.

_notes: No period and no adoption/engagement metrics stated on the page.

cardKind.jp: カリキュラム · インターフェイス

cardLine.en: Each unit leads with its real-world scenario instead of a grey tile.
cardLine.jp: 単元が、灰色のタイルではなく実際の題材から始まる。
